blocks.label: (a)
blocks.text: (a) It is unlawful for a law enforcement agency or an agent acting on behalf of the law enforcement agency to intentionally fail to comply with the provisions of subsection (a) of Section 116-4 of the Code of Criminal Procedure of 1963.

blocks.label: (b)
blocks.text: (b) Sentence. A person who violates this Section is guilty of a Class 4 felony.

blocks.label: (c)
blocks.text: (c) For purposes of this Section, "law enforcement agency" has the meaning ascribed to it in subsection (e) of Section 116-4 of the Code of Criminal Procedure of 1963.
